blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Sablayan, Oriental Mindoro Mayor Walter Marquez has warned residents about an alleged illegal recruitment scheme claiming ties to the municipal government and offering placements under the Seasonal Workers Program in South Korea. The warning came after the mayor was tipped off about a circulating email from an individual purporting to be connected with the local government. The recruiter claimed to have “approved permits” available for applicants in exchange for 337,082.01 Korean won, roughly P15,000, and promised that successful workers could bring their relatives to South Korea after completing a one-year-and-three-month contract.
